title: Cooperation in Conic Programming with Applications to Control, Production, and Portfolio
summary: We introduce the class of cooperative conic games, a new family of transferable utility games whose characteristic function can be computed by solving a conic optimization problem. This framework unifies a broad range of optimization-based cooperative games within a common mathematical formulation, encompassing linear, second-order cone, semidefinite, and other convex nonlinear optimization problems admitting conic representations. Exploiting the structural properties of conic programs and conic duality theory, we derive general conditions ensuring the existence of core payoff allocations…
